title: rosa pimpinellifolia subvar. ciliosa
intro: Rosa pimpinellifolia subvar. ciliosa, commonly known as the wild rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae that is native to China. The health benefits of Rosa pimpinellifolia subvar. ciliosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rosa pimpinellifolia subvar. ciliosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
